title: 🏛️ Exam 2025 general · reading: the bike bus to school ⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general — reading, question 1)
A text describes a weekly event at Alameda Elementary School in Portland, Oregon.

The text is mainly about an initiative that encourages school children to

options.text: travel to school in a different way
learn to repair and look after their own bikes

questions.explanation: The whole text presents the bike bus: every Wednesday a group of children rides to school together behind a teacher. That is travelling to school in a different way. Physical activity and less pollution are benefits listed in one paragraph, not the idea that covers the text, and repairing bikes is never mentioned.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general — reading, question 2, paragraph 2)
Paragraph 2 says: "The community likes it because it reduces overcrowding and pollution caused by buses and cars while also encouraging physical activity and fostering community."

The exam asks for the benefits of the bike bus on three areas. Match each benefit with its area.
questions.explanation: Physical activity is a benefit for health. Fostering community improves social life, because children and neighbours meet and share the ride. Fewer buses and cars means less overcrowding and pollution, a benefit for the environment.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general — reading, question 3, paragraph 3)
Paragraph 3 says: "Balto started the walking school bus project in 2016." and "Given its success, it quickly became a weekly Wednesday ritual at the school..."

Which word from paragraph 3 means nearly the same as "a series of actions or habits repeated frequently"?
questions.explanation: A ritual is a series of actions that people repeat in the same way, here every Wednesday. A project is a planned piece of work, a success is a good result and an aim is a goal.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general — reading, question 4, paragraph 1)
Paragraph 1 says: "...people in Portland, Oregon, go to their windows to watch a group of about 170 children ride their bikes, music trailing behind them."

What does "them" refer to?
questions.explanation: Put each noun in place of "them": the music trails behind the children who ride. "Their bikes" is the nearest plural noun before the pronoun, but it is the thing the children ride, not the group the music follows. The people and the windows stay where they are to watch.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general — reading, question 5)
The exam asks: "If you were a student at Alameda Elementary School, would you join Balto's initiative? Why? Why not?" Think about a student who says YES.

Which reasons can this student give, according to the text?

options.text: The ride is the students' favorite way to get to school.
You learn about climate change and how you can help.
The school gives a new bike to every pupil.
The ride takes place every day of the week.
You get physical activity on the way to school.

questions.explanation: The text says the bike bus has become the students' favorite way to get to school, that it is an opportunity to learn about climate change and that it encourages physical activity. The other reasons are not in the text: the ride happens every Wednesday, not every day, and bikes are offered only to students in need at other schools.
